# Carbon dioxide in air bubbles from the Law Dome ice cores, Antarctica, years 1000 to 1957, parts per million.
# Source: NOAA NCEI World Data Center for Paleoclimatology, "Law Dome Ice Core 2000-Year CO2, CH4, and N2O Data"
# (law2006.txt, last update July 2010; MacFarling Meure et al., Geophysical Research Letters 33, 2006;
# Etheridge et al. 1996, 1998): column 6, "CO2 Spline (ppm)", the CSIRO spline fit of October 2008, which damps
# variations shorter than 20 years by half. One value every ten years, plus 1769 (Watt's steam-engine patent)
# and 1957, copied unchanged.
